answer: Prompt echo names a detection rule binding each response to the published challenge text. Each agent must stake a bond and lock its answer hash beside the challenge nonce, letting peers slash mismatches. A forger cannot replay one answer across many identities, since each fake requires a fresh stake and distinct echo. Honest agents show a lantern-like signal matching the meadow of challenge terms, while farms decay under duplicate echoes. Attack cost scales with identity count, pricing fakes out of existence.
